Accelerator About us Programs Ecosystem Reports Contact EIT Climate-KIC Accelerator MED ClimAccelerator Overview Acceleration program focused on climate impact by cleantech commercialisation. It boosts innovation by supporting startups in 3 mediterranean countries: Portugal, Malta and Cyprus. ​In 3 stages, our program brings you the knowledge, resources, tools and the coaching a cleantech startup needs for success.​ Stage 1: Funding up to €5.000 Stage 2: Funding up to €20.000 Stage 3: Business Development Support Access to Europe’s largest CleanTech accelerator International Network Access to potential investors and clients Personalized Mentoring and Coaching Get Involved The program looks for innovators with ideas to takle climate change that fulfil the following criteria: -Have a breakthrough business model, exponential technology, or solution with substantial climate impact; -Core value proposition can be based on digital as well as non-digital solutions; -Proof of Concept (POC) exists, (ideally) with a proven need for the solution; -The startup is composed by a motivated team (at least two founders); -The team is committed to participate in the programme activities; -The team can work in an English-speaking environment. Venture Program About us Programs Ecosystem Reports Contact EIT Digital Venture Program Free, Hybrid Program Overview EIT Digital Venture Program is a competition for teams of entrepreneurs with strong value propositions and an existing prototype or Proof of Concept (PoC) who are eager to finalise a minimum viable product (MVP) during an intensive eight-week Pre-Acceleration Phase. Venture teams are also provided with up to €25,000 to help them launch their startup. The programme operates in five regions and will be delivered by selected EIT Digital innovation partners - Found.ation Athens, Startup Wise Guys Tallin, BGI Lisbon and ABC Accelerator Ljubljana - each covering specific countries. Get Involved Teams of entrepreneurs that are residents of Portugal and Malta To be eligible, interested teams from the above mentioned countries must fulfil the following criteria:Teams must have an innovative business idea with a PoC or prototype in Digital Industry, Digital Tech, Digital Wellbeing, Digital Finance or Digital Cities.Teams must consist of at least two members and be multidisciplinary, with technology and management skills Teams must not have already established a legal entity for the project in question. Agrifood Open Day About us Programs Ecosystem Reports Contact Apresentação A biotecnologia tem um papel crescente no setor agroalimentar europeu, com aplicações na saúde dos solos e das culturas, em novos ingredientes, em processos de fermentação de subprodutos de culturas como olival, vinha ou cereais. Para o produtor, isto traduz-se em soluções concretas: culturas mais resistentes a pragas e à seca, menor dependência de fatores de produção externos, uso mais eficiente dos recursos e novas fontes de rendimento. Neste contexto, a BGI Sustainable Ventures, com o apoio do EIT Food e da Food4Sustainability e em parceria estratégica com a Câmara Municipal de Beja, promove a 5.ª edição do Agrifood Open Day, que terá lugar no dia 11 de dezembro de 2026, no NERBE/AEBAL - Associação Empresarial do Baixo Alentejo e Litoral / CIBT, em Beja. O evento quer afirmar-se como o ponto de encontro da comunidade portuguesa focada na biotecnologia ao serviço de uma agricultura resiliente, juntando startups, investigadores, universidades, empresas, investidores, agricultores e decisores políticos. Com especial atenção à inovação deep-tech, dará visibilidade a projetos e startups com potencial de aplicação real e discutirá abertamente os obstáculos que ainda separam a investigação do mercado e do campo. Mobility Hackathon About us Programs Ecosystem Reports Contact urban mobility ‍ Applications Open: 10 September 2025 ‍ Applications close: 23 October 2025 ‍ Location Online + Final Pitch in Lisboa ‍ Date 30 October - 7 November 2025 ‍ Language Portuguese ‍ Price Free Register here Turning Data into Smarter Mobility Solutions The Urban Mobility Data Hackathon is a collaborative competition where students, professionals, and innovators can use data to design solutions for real urban mobility challenges presented by leading players in Portugal’s mobility ecosystem. Co-funded by EIT Urban Mobility and organized by BGI and Transportes Metropolitanos de Lisboa (TML), this event will bring the urban mobility community together to unlock innovation through data. Why Join? • Prizes and Opportunities Competing teams will have the chance to win a prize of up to 500€ . In addition, winning teams will receive support for their application to the EIT Jumpstarter Program and benefit from 8 hours of advisory support to further develop their idea in collaboration with TML. ‍ • Problem-Solving with Impact Tackle real-world challenges with a leading public transport operator.Dive into real datasets, uncover the key problems, and design actionable, data-driven solutions that shape the future of urban mobility and smarter cities.Gain access to real datasets from Portuguese mobility operators.

Analyze them, identify challenges, and design actionable, data-driven solutions that could shape the future of cities. • Networking and Visibility Connect with peers, mentors, municipalities, companies, and Europe’s leading mobility innovation network.

Enrich your CV, gain hands-on experience, and open new career paths in data, urban mobility, and innovation. • Shape the future of Urban Mobility Stand the chance to develop projects with leading mobility operators and municipalities in Portugal ‍ ‍ What Makes It Unique?
You will tackle real urban mobility challenges with real data from a leading Portuguese transport operator.
You will collaborate with experts, pitch to a jury, and connect directly with the organizations driving change in urban mobility.
Challenges Challenge 1 Commercial Speed The commercial speed of buses is a crucial factor for route planning, service frequency, and the quality of urban mobility.

In addition, a network optimization model could be developed with the aim of reducing delays and improving the efficiency of public transport. ‍ Challenge 2 Origin-Destination Matrices Understanding passenger mobility flows is essential for route planning and for adjusting transport supply, contributing to more sustainable urban mobility.
Data from a single mode of transport or a combination of multiple data sources may be used, enabling an integrated view of urban mobility. ‍ Who should apply?

Self-Paced Working Period 31 October to 6 November 2025 • Teams analyze the datasets and design their solution. • They can schedule at least one mentoring session with the challenge owner for feedback.
Final Pitch Event 7 November (Lisbon) A high-profile, in-person event where the teams will showcase their data-driven solutions developed to tackle the challenges proposed by the challenge owners.
The best solution will receive an award and access the possibility to deploy the Pilot with STCP Serviços.
The best solution will receive an award and the chance to deploy a real-world pilot with STCP Serviços, boosting technology validation and market adoption in the Portuguese ecosystem.

What you’ll gain? • Compete for €10,000 in prizes awarded to the top two teams ‍ • Receive expert one-on-one mentorship from top international business and mobility specialists ‍ • Validate your product idea and build a strong, investor-ready MVP ‍ • Establish your urban mobility venture with tailored venture-building support ‍ • Pitch at Demo Day in front of early-stage investors and get ready for pre-seed investment opportunities ‍ • Join Europe’s leading urban mobility innovation ecosystem ( EIT Urban Mobility ) Who should apply?* • Early-stage entrepreneurs at the concept or prototype stage ‍ • Aspiring founders in the process of venture creation ‍ • Teams and founders with technical expertise who need support on the business side ‍ • Pre-incorporation teams ‍ • Student entrepreneurs. * Teams must not be legally incorporated

Overview The Urban Mobility Startup Creation Program is an initiative led by BGI and co-financed by EIT Urban Mobility, designed to help aspiring entrepreneurs build and launch high-impact ventures in the urban mobility space.
This program supports early-stage teams in progressing from concept to MVP, through hands-on learning, mentorship, and access to key startup tools and networks.

Ultimately, it will guide participants through the journey of building their own startup in the urban mobility sector. ‍ Focus topics for the program: ‍ • ‍ Urban Logistics, • Electrification & Alternative Fuels, • Public Transport, • Mobility Data Management, • Health and Mobility. ‍ ‍ ‍ ‍ * Eligibility is not entirely limited to the topics listed above.

Program timeline & structure Phase 1: Bootcamp 22 & 29 Set 2025 | Online An intensive two-day bootcamp designed to strengthen entrepreneurial skills and tackle the core challenges early-stage teams face when building a startup.

Phase 2: Structured Mentorship ‍ 1 Oct - 25 Nov 2025 | Online An 8-week mentorship phase built around a customized Go-To-Market Plan (GTMP), guiding each team through key milestones and strategic goals.

Phase 3: Demo Day ‍ December 2025 | Online The program concludes with a high-impact Demo Day, where teams present their MVP and Go-To-Market Plan to a jury of experts and potential early-stage investors.
It is co-funded by EIT Urban Mobility and BGI.
The entire program is delivered fully online, enabling broad accessibility while ensuring high-quality mentorship, training, and peer learning.
This program is designed for early-stage ventures.

While you are free to choose what details you share during the program, all mentors collaborating with the teams in the program are required to sign a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) to ensure your intellectual property remains protected.
